summary: Started Conversation Digest Auto-Compaction v2 task with deterministic rollup scope.
Added digest kind normalization, automatic rollup compaction after create, manual compact action, rollup-first prompt formatting, frontend compact command/button, and regression tests.
Added optional model-generated conversation digest and rollup summaries with extractive fallback, digest env config, slash mode hints, and regression tests.
Added automatic digest creation after completed assistant messages with configurable message budget, auto-create helper, digest environment defaults, and regression tests.
Added conversationDigestState waterline metadata plus idle-window, cooldown, high-value signal gating, server debounce retries, frontend auto-status display, local env defaults, and regression tests.

Addressed review feedback by preventing auto-digest from re-summarizing all messages when the latest covered message id is missing; fallback now uses digest timestamp boundary and a smoke regression covers the edge case.

Added the first cross-conversation summary memory layer: digest-derived summary segment storage, /api/memory/search, digest sync/delete hooks, prompt recall of up to 5 related segments, and storage/smoke regressions.
Added matchedTerms explainability for summary memory search results across storage/API/tool responses, UI result cards, and prompt recall.

Stamped digest-derived summary memory segments with active Trellis task attribution via a resolver, wired the server to read the current task title, and added regressions for manual and automatic digest sync.

Added a manual /api/memory/backfill endpoint that idempotently syncs legacy conversationDigests metadata into searchable summary segments without implicitly assigning the current task; added smoke coverage and spec contracts.

Added a long-term memory drawer action to backfill legacy digest metadata into searchable summary segments from the UI, with explicit all-conversation semantics and user-facing progress/toast feedback.
Added bounded source-conversation title filtering for long-term summary memory search across storage, /api/memory/search, agent search-memory, prompt guidance, and the memory drawer UI.
Included the active Trellis task title in automatic summary memory recall queries so task-attributed historical segments are easier to retrieve in new conversations.

Added chat composer /memory and /mem UI-only slash commands that open the long-term summary memory drawer and optionally run the existing default cross-conversation search without creating a chat message.
Added agent search-memory --current-task/useCurrentTask support that resolves the active Trellis task into a taskName filter for cross-conversation summary memory search.
Added a UI/API current Trellis task shortcut for long-term summary memory search so the memory drawer can resolve the active task into a taskName filter without hand-copying the task name.
Added updatedAfter/updatedBefore date-window filters for long-term summary memory search across storage, /api/memory/search, agent search-memory, prompt guidance, and the memory drawer UI.
validation: node --test tests/storage/chat-store.test.js tests/smoke/server-smoke.test.js tests/runtime/agent-chat-tools.test.js tests/runtime/agent-tool-bridge.test.js tests/runtime/turn-orchestrator.test.js

summary: Added latest summary memory retrieval via /api/memory/search latest/recent mode and a UI drawer latest-memory action, so users can discover recent long-term experience without knowing a keyword first.
Added agent search-memory --latest/--recent support so agents can inspect newest bounded summary segments without a query while preserving default current-conversation exclusion.
Added automatic prompt recall fallback to latest current-task summary segments when keyword summary-memory recall returns zero results, with recall-reason prompt labeling and runtime/spec coverage.
Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now searches a larger bounded candidate pool and diversifies selected segments by source conversation before filling remaining prompt slots.
Added source task attribution to injected long-term summary memory prompt headers so agents can judge cross-task recall provenance before using historical experience.
Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now fills unused keyword-recall slots with latest current-task segments, deduplicating selected digest/segment ids and labeling fallback recall reasons.
Injected long-term summary memory prompt headers now expose digest message count, trigger reason, and created-by/model provenance so agents can judge where recalled experience came from.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now drops score-1 / single-matched-term keyword hits for multi-term generated queries before diversity selection, while preserving explicit search-memory behavior and latest current-task fallback.
Added light current-task affinity to automatic long-term summary memory recall so active-task keyword hits are considered before cross-task hits before conversation diversity selection.

Automatic long-term summary memory recall now omits generic default conversation titles such as New Conversation from generated keyword queries while preserving meaningful titles, reducing noisy LIKE terms before retrieval.
Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now orders recent public message text before long session-goal text after the active task title, protecting live-turn intent within the bounded keyword budget.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now skips backend-generated Automatic session-goal continuation boilerplate from recent-message query text so scheduler prompts do not consume the bounded keyword budget.
Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now skips agent completion reports for automatic session-goal continuations so those status broadcasts do not consume the bounded keyword budget.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now prefixes generated queries with a bounded keyword seed that reserves terms from both the active task and recent live-turn intent before SQLite LIKE term extraction.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now derives bounded recent-message seed terms from newest normalized recent messages first while keeping the full recent-message query body chronological for readability.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now clips each recent public message before global query clipping so a very long older message cannot hide newer live-turn intent from the chronological query body.

Summary-memory search term extraction is now shared by storage and automatic prompt recall, with CJK word segmentation when supported and filler-term skipping for automatic seeds so Chinese task/recent intent can drive LIKE recall without exact whole-sentence matches.

Summary-memory query extraction now falls back to deterministic bounded CJK bigrams when Intl.Segmenter is unavailable or opaque, preserving Chinese memory recall without exact whole-sentence matches.
Summary-memory search now honors the automatic prompt recall candidate budget of 15 rows end-to-end instead of truncating store results at 10 before source-conversation diversity can run.
Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now treats slug-like and title-like task names as the same active-task affinity when prioritizing keyword hits before cross-task results.

Automatic prompt summary-memory latest current-task fallback now performs a bounded alias pass when exact task-title filtering finds nothing, so slug-stamped task memories can still fill unused prompt slots.

Automatic prompt summary-memory recall now skips private-only and private-visibility recent messages when building cross-conversation retrieval queries, keeping private mailbox/game context out of long-term memory recall terms.
Summary memory now exposes a lightweight health endpoint and drawer status that self-tests latest search, reports segment counts/latest segment, and flags metadata digests waiting for backfill.

Summary-memory health now returns bounded unsynced digest details and manual backfill reports digest-level sync failures instead of hiding failed writes; the memory drawer surfaces the first reason in status/toasts.

Added a bounded same-agent retrieval trace cache for successful search-memory results, storing source digest snippets in conversation metadata and injecting Last recalled evidence cache into the next prompt before conversation history.
